sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The game's controls are simple and intuitive, making it easy to pick up and play. With the use of WASD keys or mobile touch controls, you'll be able to move Pirate Jack left and right, as well as jump and double jump to reach those hard-to-access areas.

One of the key mechanics that sets Pirate Jack apart is its use of double jumping. This feature allows you to jump twice in a row, giving you the freedom to explore the ship's vertical areas with ease. The game also features a variety of obstacles and enemies, from spiky floors to laser beams, that will test your reflexes and timing. As you progress through the levels, the game's difficulty curve will increase, requiring you to be fast and agile to overcome the challenges.

But don't worry if you're new to platformers – Pirate Jack's controls are designed to be easy to pick up, and the game's tutorial levels will guide you through the basics.
